clips.title: The story
paras: The High Rise gathers Thunder Bluff's tribes around its central fire, high above Mulgore.

At Thunder Bluff's summit, the High Rise catches the open winds above Mulgore's rolling plains. Tauren gather in its open-air amphitheater around a fire pit to hear tribal announcements and witness decisions. Tents and wooden stalls hold merchants, armories, and culinary trainers, including Aska's Kitchen and Mountaintop Bait & Tackle. The lower tiers reach Mulgore's prairie floor by massive wooden elevators, but no elevator connects the plains to the High Rise. The wind rider roost and rope bridges to Elder Rise and Hunter Rise provide the way up.
